description: The plot illustrates layer-wise relative change values for several token/precision configurations, with a constant baseline for reference. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and uses a categorical scale with five groups: Layer1–4, Layer5–12, Layer13–20, Layer21–28, and Layer29–32. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and is on a linear percent scale ranging from about −25% to 5%, with labeled ticks at 5%, 0%, −5%, −15%, and −25%. A gray dashed horizontal baseline labeled “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit” stays at 0% across all layer groups. The yellow solid line with circular markers (“LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit”) is near 0% at Layer1–4 and Layer5–12, dips to roughly −2% at Layer13–20, returns to about 0% at Layer21–28, and ends slightly above 0% (around +0.5%) at Layer29–32. The red solid line with square markers (“LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”) is at about 0% at Layer1–4, around −1% at Layer5–12, reaches roughly −4.5% at Layer13–20, rises to about −1.5% at Layer21–28, and ends near −0.5% at Layer29–32. The light blue solid line with circular markers (“RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”) is around −2% at Layer1–4, about −2.5% at Layer5–12, drops to roughly −13% at Layer13–20, rises to about −2.5% at Layer21–28, and ends near −1.5% at Layer29–32. The dark blue solid line with square markers (“RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”) is around −3% at Layer1–4, about −4.5% at Layer5–12, drops to approximately −25% at Layer13–20, rises to about −5.5% at Layer21–28, and ends near −3.5% at Layer29–32.
caption_used: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as the pruning method, are shown. The plot illustrates the relative change across different layer groupings, with the x-axis labeled 'Layer' and the y-axis labeled 'Relative Change'. The gray dashed line represents the baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit, which remains constant at 0% across all layers. The yellow line (LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit) shows a steady trend, with a slight dip to approximately -5% at Layer13-20 before returning to 0%. The red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit) follows a similar pattern, dipping to -10% at Layer13-20 and recovering to 0% by Layer29-32. The light blue line (RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit) starts at -2%, dips to -15% at Layer13-20, and rises back to -2% by Layer29-32. The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) begins at -4%, drops sharply to -30% at Layer13-20, and recovers to -5% by Layer29-32. Overall, the LB-Avg methods demonstrate more stability compared to the RULER4k methods, which exhibit sharper declines at intermediate layers.
